description: Land Aquisition - Neddukkadu, Poonakary D/S Division Kilinochchi District.
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically dealing with compensation deposits for acquired lands, including detailed descriptions of land parcels, locations, and compensation amounts. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
